items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: Britt came out and Floyd hired him. But I didn't go in the band.

ctx.x: : yeah, I heard something -- Yeah, I got him on that band.
(Inaudible) -- Well, I was in the band with him, man, I was in the band before Britt. That's how Britt got in the band, because Harry Battles had come over and stood

behind my back when I was -- in those days, I was studying, I could read very well, except syncopation was a little rough on me, the classical (inaudible) syncopation like that. (Singing.) That's what the bass part looked like. So Harry Battles was going to help me. "Hey, man, look, you should do that this way." I said, "Fuck it, man," and threw the bass down.
